key.name: move-from-header-bars
key.summary: Move the window by dragging its header bars
key.description: Whether dragging the header bars of the window and of its dialogs moves the window, as it does in other applications; it can be turned off when the window manager moves windows by itself, as tiling window managers do. It applies to the windows and dialogs opened afterwards

key.name: volume
key.description: The playback volume, as the volume slider shows it

key.name: restore-playlist
key.description: Whether the queue keeps its tracks from the last session. A selected saved playlist is always reopened. Opening the application with files replaces the queue

key.name: resume-points
key.summary: Where playback was in each playlist
key.description: By playlist name (empty for the queue): the URI of the current track, its index in the order the tracks were added, and the position in seconds, to go on from there when the playlist is opened, at startup or when switching back to it

key.name: selected-playlist
key.description: The name of the saved playlist that is played and that tracks are added to; empty for the queue

key.name: sleep-timer-minutes
key.description: The number of minutes the sleep timer was last set to

key.name: sleep-timer-finish-track
key.summary: Finish the last track when the sleep timer runs out
key.description: Whether the music stops at the end of the track that is playing when the sleep timer runs out, instead of right away

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: The width of the playlist sidebar, in pixels; 0 means the width is computed automatically

key.name: album-sort
key.summary: What the albums are sorted by
key.description: The albums in the grid are sorted by artist, title, year, or the date they were added to the Music folder

key.name: album-sort-order
key.summary: The direction the albums are sorted in
key.description: Whether the albums in the grid are sorted in ascending or descending order
